items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: Jetta Rola was very temperamental... I'm the boss... You'd be there on time, ready to play. Dink come there...

ctx.x: Well, Dink always come late and Jetta Rola was very temperamental. You know, he had to be there on time. It's all right for him to walk in. Well, I'm the boss. I don't have nothing to do. Boom. He'd stomp on me, there we go. You'd be there on time, ready to play. Dink come there and take him a half an hour to set up his drum. Yeah. I heard he passed.
Yes, about 1954 or several years ago. About four years ago in November, I think. Didn't I? Up in Portland.
